name: Bournemouth

queries.query: site:gov.uk Bournemouth land registry cadastral parcel map INSPIRE
queries.result: Found HM Land Registry's official INSPIRE Index Polygons dataset and the GOV.UK index-map procedure. The dataset is divided by local authority and the current download page lists Bournemouth Christchurch and Poole Council.

queries.query: Bournemouth official parcel map cadastral land registry local land charges BCP Council
queries.result: BCP Council official pages document local land charges for most BCP properties, council land boundary records, and an interactive mapping service; the parcel geometry source itself is HM Land Registry's national INSPIRE service.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons: indicative extent and position of registered freehold properties in England and Wales, published as local-authority files; the current download listing includes Bournemouth Christchurch and Poole Council.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The official metadata and download page establish the BCP local-authority package and national service scope, but the archive could not be fetched anonymously during this attempt.

officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official catalogue describes INSPIRE Index Polygons as freehold registered-property locations, divided by local authority, under the UK Open Government Licence.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: HM Land Registry / Use land and property data service
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Current first-party download page listed 'Bournemouth Christchurch and Poole Council' and a GML archive link.

Local authority procedure page states that BCP keeps a register for the majority of properties and accepts parcel-supported searches; this is a local registry/procedure lead, not the cadastral geometry endpoint.
Public WMS capabilities returned the CP.CadastralParcel layer, EPSG:27700/CRS:84 support, and England/Wales extent.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official download page returned and exposed the BCP archive link.
Anonymous archive request did not yield the GML; no CAPTCHA or challenge bypass was attempted and no geometry was retained.
WMS capabilities returned CP.CadastralParcel, EPSG:27700 and CRS:84.
Public endpoint explicitly returned 'Service WFS is disabled'; no feature response was obtained.
Bounded exact-point GetFeatureInfo attempt was rejected because the cadastral layer is not queryable; this is not evidence of absence.
The linked map host served an IIS default page during this attempt; no usable viewer configuration or API was exposed.

blocker: The source is relevant and authoritative, but no anonymous parcel geometry response was obtained in this attempt; serial review must independently qualify any adapter.
remainingUncertainty: The official source establishes local-authority package scope, not complete citywide availability at the WUP point. The archive challenge, disabled WFS and non-queryable WMS prevent a bounded polygon sample. Exact-point non-response is not treated as citywide absence.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently retry the official BCP GML download or another first-party endpoint, verify INSPIREID semantics and CRS conversion, and retain no more than three polygons if safely obtained.
identityPolicy: No GeoJSON sample was retained. If later retained, properties must contain exactly one canonical native identity, preferably INSPIREID; native field mapping remains metadata-only.
